name: submissions_public
description:
Contains the scored submissions on the GAIA benchmark, validation set only.
To avoid contamination of GAIA and leakage of the answers, please do not reshare the current dataset without any gating system or outside of the HF hub.
reputation: A restricted collection of scored submissions for the GAIA benchmark (validation set only); primarily useful to contributors and researchers working with GAIA but intentionally gated to avoid leakage.
